subject: general
question: Which Article deals with protection of life and personal liberty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 21**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 21** of the Constitution of India deals with the **protection of life and personal liberty**.
 
• It states that **"No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law."**
 
• Article 21 is considered one of the most important articles in the Indian Constitution as it guarantees the fundamental right to life and personal liberty.
 
• This article has been interpreted by the Supreme Court of India to include various derivative rights such as the right to privacy, the right to a healthy environment, and the right to live with dignity.
 
• It acts as a safeguard against the arbitrary actions of the state and ensures that any deprivation of life or personal liberty must follow a fair, just, and reasonable procedure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 21** has been expansively interpreted by the judiciary to cover a wide range of rights, making it one of the most dynamic provisions in the Constitution.
 
• It has been judicially expanded to include the right to shelter, the right to livelihood, the right to health, and the right to education, among others.
 
• The protection under Article 21 is available to both **citizens and non-citizens of India**.
 
• It is part of the fundamental rights enshrined in Part III of the Constitution, which are enforceable by the courts, ensuring that any violation can be challenged in the judiciary.
 
• Article 21 has played a crucial role in the development of constitutional jurisprudence in India, particularly in the realm of human rights.
